pr_body:
The test failure happens as we choose same ids with `"snap-" + randomAlphaOfLength(3)`. This change uses UUID for ids to minimize the change of collisions.

Closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/101583
pr_comments:
> but also do you think we should add a toString() to SnapshotDetails?

Yeah, I could add that

> Also why a UUID and not randomIdentifier()?

This test relies on generating up to 9 unique identifiers without using `randomValueOtherThan(...)`.
`randomIdentifier()` generates 8-12 askii characters with `AsciiLettersGenerator` (actually limited only to English characters). I believe random UUID could have way more random values and there less chance of collisions.
